[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Make your bed every morning to set a productive tone for the day.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Put away items after use to prevent clutter buildup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Use storage containers and bins to keep items organized.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Keep surfaces clear to make cleaning easier.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Schedule a weekly deep clean for dusting, vacuuming, and changing sheets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Don't let laundry pile up to keep the bedroom floor clear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Consider a "one in, one out" policy to prevent clutter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Make tidying a habit by incorporating it into the daily routine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips included using a bedside caddy, a laundry sorter, a small trash can, and investing in a bed with built-in storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized that tidying is a process and encouraged starting with small changes.
